title: Broken Items
description: A funny texture with broken items.
body:
Broken Items Texture Pack – 16x16

This resource pack changes the look of items in Minecraft to appear broken, cracked, and damaged.

 Features:

* Swords, tools, and items redesigned with a broken/cracked style
* Unique damaged textures for a more intense and gritty look
* Clear visuals while keeping PvP-friendly visibility
* 16x16 resolution for smooth performance

 Gameplay Experience:
Adds a new visual feeling to the game by making your gear look worn and battle-used. Perfect for players who want a different, more realistic or chaotic style.

 Style:
A rough and broken aesthetic that gives items a used and damaged appearance, while still staying clean and easy to recognize.

If you're looking for a unique twist on classic Minecraft textures – this pack is for you!
